CustomField.label: Satisfaction min (3 Monate)
CustomField.description: Minimum Customer_Satisfaction__c (1-5) over the same rolling 3-month window as Satisfaction_Durchdurch__c (SCRUM-442). null = no data. Expresses the PO-rule "at least one Case with score 1 or 2 in the window". System-maintained by AccountSatisfactionRebuilder; von Hand nicht änderbar.
